title: Tribblix: The retro Illumos distribution
summary: Tribblix is an Illumos-based operating system distribution that brings the legacy SunOS/OpenSolaris computing environment to modern hardware, with a focus on retro compatibility and traditional Unix values.
problem_solved: Provides access to the Illumos/Solaris ecosystem with emphasis on backward compatibility for legacy Solaris applications and system administration practices.
why_valuable: Preserves the decades-long Unix computing heritage while leveraging modern Illumos innovations like ZFS and DTrace, serving niche users who need Solaris compatibility.
